name: sz_oneway_held
about: ONE WAY in the hands of a real joined player (forge run --joined --fs-game mods/szoneway --mod-ff <mod.ff>): the mod weapon iw7_szoneway_zm given at the player's spawn, frames of the joined client after the raise and after a pause. Its own view model on its own 22-bone skeleton; the animations are the stock FTL pistol's (stand-in). Stock spawning off.
